about: gates/verify-join.sh counts 'toolchain: playwright' lines only inside gate sections (from '=== name ===' to the next section, '--- ' or the PASS-total footer), so the suite footer's 'instrument: toolchain: ...' line, which every full suite writes, no longer refuses every real joined log as TWO TOOLCHAINS; two different lines printed by the gates are still refused. Graded by gates/suite-resume-selftest.sh (shell, no browser), its judge arms only: TC-R241c19/c20 (the synthetic same-toolchain and two-toolchain joins built from 474-integration-all.log), c23 (the same join with the REAL footer line from claude/agents/gatelogs/552f-all-job25-resumed-RED-147-only.log is JOIN OK), c24 (the two-toolchain join with that footer still refused, counting 2), c25 (the real joined log 552f, 552e killed at gate 46 and resumed, is JOIN OK at 159 sections in 2 parts) and c26 (that real log with one gate's toolchain line changed to another Chromium is refused). One situation, because no screen is driven. NOT COVERED: verify-log.sh's own verdict on 552f, which stays REFUSED on its GATES RED #552 footer, as it should.

breaks.name: counts-the-footer-again
breaks.why: the toolchain count greps the whole log again, footer included - the defect itself, so the real 552f join is refused as TWO TOOLCHAINS

breaks.name: section-never-closes-at-the-footer
breaks.why: the section bounds no longer end at the PASS-total line, so the last section runs on into the footer and its instrument line is counted as a gate's

breaks.name: toolchain-count-dropped
breaks.why: the over-correction: the TWO TOOLCHAINS refusal is switched off, so a join whose gates ran on two Chromium builds is accepted
